credentialBoundary: Root alone reads the protected local environment file and launches the released runner with only named settings. Workers must not open protected environment, key, URI, mailbox, or credential files.
requirements: Prepare a guarded real-driver runner for exact frozen ATLAS01-10 purposes, with no product source or matrix edits
Execute only after root GO in the single explicit astra_test_live_validation_20261026 database with native reviewed persistence/store sources and strict TLS
Enforce a small bounded operation budget, unique synthetic tenant IDs and run markers; never enumerate or read customer databases or collections
Record real transaction/index/idempotency/reconnect and cross-tenant behavior where actually exercised; mocks or constructor checks alone cannot satisfy real-service cases
No production fault injection, database drop, collection drop, credential changes or migrations; failure recovery must use isolated session/client controls or unique synthetic transaction records
Cleanup may delete only synthetic records created by this exact run and must prove unrelated sentinel records and preexisting records were not changed
Retain initial failure evidence, measured per-case operations, exact source/runner before-after pins, typed observed assertions, provider operation counts and sanitized reproduction steps
Report unsupported tests as BLOCKED or NOT_RUN and confirmed defects as FAIL; no route-only or mock PASS claims
No raw URI, credentials, personal information, secret-value hashes or private fixture fingerprints in evidence or raw driver logs
Independent review and coordinator scenario binding remain required before any matrix registration
